page: Microsoft Azure DC96eds_v5 is a dedicated virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV5 server family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors, this instance features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The virtualization environment is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server type includes 2891 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC96eds_v5 offers high resource density with dedicated CPU allocation and substantial local storage capacity, making it suitable for enterprise workloads. The combination of 96 dedicated vCPUs, 384.0 GB of RAM, and local storage makes this instance appropriate for memory-optimized applications, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and data-intensive processing tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure DC96eds_v5 is a dedicated virtual machine from the DCEDV5 family, designed for memory-optimized and storage-heavy workloads. Running on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, it provides 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, resulting in 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance is equipped with 2891 GB of local storage and supports premium storage configurations, though it lacks GPU accelerators and complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile delivers high resource density for demanding enterprise applications. It is best suited for large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and data-processing workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources and high-capacity local storage.
